external_authority.closest_vector_lattice_precedent: M. G. Delgadino and S. A. Smith, Mass generation for the two dimensional O(N) Linear Sigma Model in the large N limit, arXiv:2601.19630v1, especially Definition 3.1 and Appendix D for vector lattice-to-continuum total variation and inherited reflection positivity
external_authority.multivariate_terminal_measure: H. Nagoji, Construction of the Gibbs measures associated with Euclidean quantum field theory with various polynomial interactions in the Wick renormalizable regime, arXiv:2305.19583v2, Theorem 1.7(i) and Proposition A.1

Bernabei and Z.-M. Zhou, On the continuum limit of lattice approximations to phi4_2 models, J. Math. Phys. 45 (2004)

external_authority.not_imported: The O(N) quartic is radial and has a scalar counterterm. It does not prove the non-radial Q3 twelve-edge polynomial estimate, the centered CL8 unit dictionary, the Q3 matrix counterterm, the twisted seam limit, or the original three-dimensional parent. No world-first claim is made.

statement: For the registered inserted-one-dimensional CL8 Hamiltonian with w=a/8, physical Euclidean time delta=hbar*t, isotropic coordinate tau=sqrt(c/chi)*delta and field phi=s*q with s^2=sqrt(chi*c)/(8*hbar), the Euclidean lattice action has canonical derivative coefficients and circumference beta0=hbar*beta_H*sqrt(c/chi). Its quadratic and quartic couplings are K_E=K_CL8/c, g_E=8*hbar*g/(sqrt(chi)*c^(3/2)) and lambda_E=8*hbar*lambda/(sqrt(chi)*c^(3/2)). The centered free covariance has symbol [nu_n^2+m0^2+khat_a(k)^2]^(-1), khat_a^2=4a^(-2)sin^2(ak/2). The symbol sandwich (4/pi^2)k^2<=khat_a^2<=k^2, common Fourier-white-noise coupling and dominated convergence give full-sequence convergence in L2(Omega;H^(-s)) for every s>0 to the massive spectral Gaussian field. The same two-rank time-circle covariance factorization proves finite-regulator reflection positivity, which passes to the free limit; the free joint Weyl characteristics converge on every fixed mode space, at O(a^2) on bounded labels. For the renormalized Q3 matrix-counterterm family, every Wick monomial of degree at most four converges in L2. Continuous-space chaos kernels converge by the covariance-symbol sandwich; nodal quadrature differs only by finitely many total-spatial-momentum alias sectors ell*M, whose coefficients vanish by the Riemann-Lebesgue lemma because powers of the massive Green kernel are integrable. Fixed-chaos hypercontractivity upgrades this to every fixed finite Lp. This does not yet imply convergence of the exponential densities. A uniform exponential-integrability estimate for the centered nodal family is still required. The original fixed-raw quadratic CL8 family is not the required renormalized family: since C_M grows logarithmically, K_R(M)=K_raw+3C_M[(g_E+lambda_E)I+lambda_E L_Q3] diverges in every Walsh sector. A fixed finite K_R requires K_raw(M)=K_R-3C_M[(g_E+lambda_E)I+lambda_E L_Q3], up to the declared scalar convention. At every finite regulator, the symmetric Weyl operator has the exact heat-kernel seam formula chi(f,h)=Z^(-1) integral exp[i<f,x>_w/hbar] K_beta(x+h/2,x-h/2)dx. It supplies the correct off-diagonal target, but the interacting continuum regular CCR state still requires pointwise seam convergence and uniform identity equicontinuity on each fixed symplectic mode space.

unit_dictionary.physical_Euclidean_time: delta=hbar*t, where t and beta_H have inverse-energy units
unit_dictionary.canonical_action: integral_0^beta0 d tau a sum_j [(|partial_tau phi_j|^2+|D_a phi_j|^2)/2+P_E(phi_j)]
unit_dictionary.base_Gaussian_residual: for covariance (-Delta+m0^2)^(-1), K_int=K_E-m0^2 I plus the declared finite Q3-matrix part
unit_dictionary.boundary: hbar, chi, c, beta_H and the inserted one-dimensional reduction remain supplied inputs; this dictionary does not derive time, hbar, physical light, or the three-dimensional parent

centered_free_limit.covariance: G_M(n,k)=[nu_n^2+m0^2+4a^(-2)sin^2(ak/2)]^(-1) on the time circle and spatial Brillouin zone
centered_free_limit.common_coupling: use the same Fourier white noises for the centered and spectral multipliers
centered_free_limit.strong_distribution_limit: phi_M tends to phi in L2(Omega;H^(-s)(T^2)) for every s>0 along the full sequence
centered_free_limit.tightness: uniform H^(-s0) second moments for every s0>0 and compact Sobolev embedding give the equivalent weak-tightness route
centered_free_limit.reflection_positivity: for omega_(M,k)=sqrt(m0^2+khat_a(k)^2), the reflected time-circle covariance is the sum of the same two positive rank-one kernels as the spectral family
centered_free_limit.free_Weyl: the thermal quasifree joint q-p Weyl characteristic converges on every fixed mode set; the fixed-mode centered-symbol error is O(a^2)
centered_free_limit.boundary: this is a free massive inserted-1+1 comparator, not an interacting or physical-vacuum theorem

centered_Q3_Wick_limit.family: the EXP-000765 renormalized Q3 matrix-counterterm family after the exact unit rescaling, not the original cutoff-independent raw CL8 polynomial
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.continuous_kernel_step: for each Wick degree d<=4, the centered continuous-x chaos kernel converges to the spectral kernel by pointwise multiplier convergence and the uniform covariance sandwich
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.nodal_alias_step: the nodal zero mode equals the exact zero-total-momentum sector plus finitely many alias sectors with total spatial momentum ell*M, 0<|ell|<=d/2
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.alias_decay: the alias coefficients tend to zero because the massive Green kernel power C^d is in L1 on the two-torus and its Fourier coefficients vanish at infinity
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.result: the integrated Q3 Wick interaction R_M^nod converges to the same terminal interaction R in L2 and, by finite-chaos hypercontractivity, in every fixed finite Lp
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.low_band_fixture: when every spatial input has bandwidth K and M>4K, all degree-at-most-four nodal quadrature is exactly nonaliased
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.missing_density_lemma: prove sup_M E exp[(1+eta)R_M^nod]<infinity for some eta>0, preferably eta=1, on the exact centered-dispersion/nodal family
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.consequence_if_closed: Vitali then gives full-sequence common-space L1 density convergence to the unique Nagoji Q3 measure and passes reflection positivity
centered_Q3_Wick_limit.boundary: finite-Lp convergence of R_M does not itself control exp(R_M)

counterterm_necessity.Walsh_eigenvalues: g_E+lambda_E+2s*lambda_E for s=0,1,2,3, all positive when g_E>0 and lambda_E>=0
counterterm_necessity.fixed_raw_failure: if K_raw is independent of M and C_M grows like log M, every eigenvalue of K_R(M) diverges to positive infinity and cannot approach a fixed finite Nagoji quadratic
counterterm_necessity.required_tuning: K_raw(M)=K_R-3C_M A_Q3, up to the scalar energy convention
counterterm_necessity.thermal_vacuum_change: if the Hamiltonian is already Wick ordered at zero-temperature C_0,M, changing to the beta-circle covariance C_beta,M adds only the finite matrix shift -3(C_0,M-C_beta,M)A_Q3

twisted_Weyl_seam.path_boundary: the Feynman-Kac seam is q_beta=q_0+h and the phase is evaluated at the endpoint midpoint; endpoint reversal sends h to -h
twisted_Weyl_seam.free_Cameron_Martin_cost: |h|^2/(4 kappa_a beta)=chi ||h||_(2,w)^2/(2 hbar^2 beta), kappa_a=hbar^2/(2chi w)
twisted_Weyl_seam.regular_CCR_criterion: on every fixed symplectic mode space, prove pointwise convergence of all seam scalars and uniform equicontinuity at the Weyl identity; positivity then passes from the finite Weyl matrices and the limit is regular
twisted_Weyl_seam.open_estimate: prove a cutoff-uniform fixed-low-mode momentum bound or directly a locally uniform off-diagonal seam bound; diagonal configuration-density convergence is only the h=0 sector

L2_without_UI.witness: X_N=N on an event of probability N^(-4) and zero otherwise
L2_without_UI.facts: ||X_N||_2=N^(-1) tends to zero while E exp(X_N)=1-N^(-4)+N^(-4)exp(N) diverges
L2_without_UI.consequence: finite-Lp Wick convergence cannot replace a uniform exponential moment; this is an inference no-go, not a counterexample to the actual Q3 family

gate_resolution.status: UNIT DICTIONARY, CENTERED FREE FULL-SEQUENCE RP/WEYL LIMIT, Q3 WICK FINITE-LP LIMIT, COUNTERTERM NECESSITY, AND FINITE TWISTED SEAM CLOSED; INTERACTING DENSITY AND CONTINUUM REGULAR-CCR LIMITS OPEN

verification.fixtures: symbolic CL8 Euclidean coefficient rescaling; centered-symbol sandwich and fixed-mode O(a^2); H^(-s) Fourier tails; DFT alias-sector enumeration and exact low-band quadrature; finite convolution-tail decay; Q3 Wick covariance translation and Walsh levels; fixed-raw divergence and tuned cancellation; centered reflected-circle Gram matrices; Weyl BCH midpoint seam and harmonic characteristic; rare-spike L2-without-exponential-UI control; prior-art, scope, below-empty-space, and unchanged-C6 firewalls

prior_art_boundary: Scalar P(phi)2 and vector O(N) lattice-to-continuum construction, total-variation convergence, reflection positivity, Feynman-Kac/OS reconstruction and Weyl algebras are established subjects. The complete TECT C0/N1-N5/CP1/Pre-A sequence was not located as one proved predecessor, but absence from this bounded search is not a novelty theorem. The repository-specific work here is the exact CL8 unit map, non-radial Q3 matrix-counterterm necessity, direct centered-nodal Q3 chaos/alias calculation, and exact typing of the remaining exponential and off-diagonal seam estimates.
no_overclaim: This package does not prove the centered interacting densities converge, because the exact uniform exponential-integrability estimate is open. It does not prove an interacting continuum regular Weyl state, because the off-diagonal seam and fixed-low-mode momentum bounds are open. It does not identify the original fixed-raw CL8 Hamiltonians with a finite renormalized Q3 theory. It does not prove complete OS/Markov/Hadamard structure, a physical phase transition, a selected beta or ground state, the original three-dimensional Q3 parent, a physical vacuum or below-empty-space sign, physical light, C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, or Pre-A.
